# Delete Geometry

Removes the selected splats, points or mesh vertices from your scene.

`lfs.delete_geometry` · Geometry

## How to use

Connect a selection before connecting Geometry.  
An unconnected Selection removes everything; mesh faces touching removed vertices also go.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | What you remove: weights of 0.5 or more are deleted. Unconnected means everything, so the output is empty. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |
